body:

Full rationale is in the changeset (`.changeset/meta-object-search-companion-agreement.md`), which is the dev's own text and the authoritative description.

⚠️ **Hot-file note for reviewers:** this touches `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, both of which had concurrent editors in this lane today. `origin/main` is already merged into the branch (see the merge commit).
